title: A/P Detail: lines that stop loading while scrolling leave a message
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin user (the "Admin" role).
  • Make sure you can switch this computer's network connection off and on (such as Wi-Fi).
  • Have a bucket, bucket A, with more than 100 lines on today's date, so its later lines load as you scroll.
  • Use a desktop browser window 1440 px wide.
  • Open A/P Detail (Reports, then "A/P Aging Detail" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu).
custom_steps:
1. Expand bucket A.
  2. Switch the computer's network connection off.
  3. Scroll down to the end of bucket A's lines.
  4. Switch the network back on.
  5. Collapse bucket A.
  6. Expand bucket A.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Bucket A opens with its first 100 lines.

Step 2:

  • The computer is offline.

Step 3:

  • The 100 lines already shown stay, and under them the bucket shows "Not every line loaded. Collapse and expand this bucket to try again."

Step 4:

  • The computer is online again.

Step 5:

  • Bucket A collapses.

Step 6:

  • Bucket A opens with its first 100 lines again, with no message.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 11 (5 Nov 2026, Chris Ward), read 10 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • Story 4, Error Handling: “If a bucket's later lines stop loading while the user scrolls, the lines already shown stay and the bucket shows "Not every line loaded. Collapse and expand this bucket to try again." under them.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “A bucket's later lines stop loading | "Not every line loaded. Collapse and expand this bucket to try again." | Inside the bucket, under the lines already shown”
  • S4-R4: “On A/R Detail and A/P Detail, expanding a bucket (by hand or with Expand all) shows its first 100 lines, then loads more as the user scrolls. This is as today on A/P Detail and new on A/R Detail, which today shows a whole bucket at once.”

Not yet checked against a build: the QA build v26.45.2-6a8b89c exists since 10 Nov 2026 and this case has not been run on it yet.
